description: Find up to five query-matching passages inside one known document without returning its full body. Use for precise facts, methods, results, or quotations; copy uri from a search hit.

query.description: Specific evidence to locate inside the document. There is no two-word query or phrase limit. Preserve complete concepts and relationships; use full natural-language questions when useful. Quote established phrases whose wording must appear, including three-to-eight-word technical terms or longer known titles. Example: "long term exposure to air pollution" respiratory morbidity and mortality. Leave uncertain wording unquoted. For claim verification, search the relationship rather than requiring the entire statement verbatim. Every quoted span is required; multiple spans mean ALL, not alternatives. Matching uses ordered normalized indexed tokens, not byte-exact text; straight, curly, and guillemet quote pairs work. If results are sparse, relax optional phrases and explain the broader search; preserve wording the user explicitly requires. A fully quoted query is appropriate when locating a known quotation; verify its literal wording in source text.

search_result.description: When reading a search hit, copy its id into document_id and the response trajectory verbatim here. This links the read attempt to that search. Omit for a URI obtained elsewhere.

document_id.description: The hit's id, copied verbatim from that response.

trajectory.description: The trajectory object of the search or research response that returned this hit, copied whole.

feedback_token.description: trajectory.feedback_token from that same response; it ties this call to that result set.

uri.description: source_uri copied from a search hit. Optional with search_result for a library hit (its id is used, also when source_uri is null); required for web hits. Web pages are read live.

name: machinelibrary_search_in_document

message.description: Actionable guidance when no passage matched.

next_step.description: When to follow up with machinelibrary_comment_on_document.

note.description: Attribution reminder for reads without search_result.

evidence.description: Selected answer excerpt within text. Offset counts Unicode scalar values; relevance score is separate from retrieval score.

title: Find passages in one document
